artifacts.summary: Corrects the Determined/Deterministic claim into three distinct collapse phenomena; records the paper's committed and git-recovered statements (def:deterministic, lem:deterministic-singleton, app:deterministic, app:drift, cor:no-characterization, app:deterministic-future, Theorem C); delivers the machine-checked deterministic collapse, the F-zero/F-one indistinguishable pair as legal task frames, the direction-indexed choice-dependence finding, and a narrowed store/recall recommendation.
Sorry-free, choice-free: TaskFrame.IsDeterministic, the forward singleton bridge, the collapse StarTruthAt (stab phi) <-> StarTruthAt phi, and Determined as a frame validity (45 lines, compiles).

Sorry-free: F-zero (the drift frame over the reals) as a FrameOver with all six axioms including limit and saturation, its non-determinism, the full order-isomorphism core (bounds, Lipschitz, continuity, strict monotonicity, forward/backward IVT surjectivity), and F-one with its determinism (272 lines, compiles).
